details: macOS 1.0.77, firmware DM32.NRF.01.049, CH340-style /dev/cu.usbserial: two full reads succeeded, then during the write one 0x1000-byte flash read returned 4007 of 4102 bytes after 5 s and the stock driver stopped. Reads are idempotent; the block read is now retried up to 3 times.
summary: Write stops on one short 4 KiB flash read ("Bad reply reading flash at 020000")
